book.title: Aposel Yon bung xailongdi mala rangua riang hatuminga haringinamdi. Tauxu xailong mugamugangamga li ba, 1 Yon

content: Tatuba Haruanga Maxunama Xaung Haruanga Languangama

Riagu mana, labu ahatum haringina mana lipu longgalo hatumingadingdiu tai. Ne asuxuya lipua hatuminganoa to, bu axabia ba ma rangua Urana Aningonoa kimbo tegu. Namua na lipu xumana dila mana titi hataing hataindi, dilangua ba ding Urana lipuxing suxunguxunguamdi dibaxanga.
Bagula abagu axabia Urana Aningonoa wa ranguadi bila li: Nabu dibaxanga ba Yesu Kristo sok lipu sibuna, bing haruangadingdi dima rangua Urana.
Ne nabu lipu tela baxanga Yesu bila ba te, bing ma rangua Urana te. Kristo bixuanoa ba hatuminganoa naga. Alungu ba hatuminga ba mau, saing hatata wa masup titia li.
Garagu mana, ang Urana lipuxindi binabu adalidi masup, namua na Urana Aningonoa wa maluxu mang ba dali lipu dianoa wa liwe mana lipu titiamdi.
Ding lipu titiamdi, binabu daharua mana axamang titiamdi, saing lipu titiamdi dilungudi.

Ne am ba Urana lipuxindi, saing lipu gaxarea daxabia Urana dilunguam. Ne lipu gaxarea Urana lipuxindi te dilunguam te. Daxanga naga tabagu taxabia ba hatuminga maxunama ma rangua Urana Aningonoa, xaung hatuminga languangama ma rangua lipu murakkama.
Urana Bing Kubolu Murungam Sibuna Namua
Riagu mana, bing murura sibuna makira, namua na kubolu murunga sibuna ma rangua Urana. Lipu gaxarea murung sibuna, ina Urana garanoa saing xabia Urana.
Lipu gaxarea murung sibuna te xabia Urana te, namua na Urana bing kubolu murungam sibuna namua.
Urana hatanga kubolung murungam sibuna makira bila li: Soxi Garang taininau mari titia bu kira taxap walingua mana oxatanoa.

Kubolu murungam sibuna bila li: Kira murura sibuna mana Urana muga te. Tegu. Ina murung sibuna makira muga, saing soxi Garanoa bu wa hananiangua libu Urana atin daxaringa mana kubolura diandi, sisiadi.
Riagu mana, nabu Urana murung sibuna makira sabanga sibuna bila ba, bing murura sibuna makira xauna.
Lipu tela bagu Urana te. Ne nabu murura sibuna makira, bing Urana taga rangua kira, saing tahatanga ba murungang sibunoa baxagi sibuna makira.
Taxabia ba tataga rangua xaung ina taga rangua kira, namua na sina Aningonoa nakira.
Baing am gabagu maxamamia xaung am gabaxanga ba Tibura soxi Garanoa bu wa Lipu Xabinga Muliama mana lipu titiamdi.
Lipu gaxarea baxanga ba Yesu Urana Garanoa, bing Urana taga rangua saing ina taga rangua xauna.

Binabu taxabia xai xaung tahatum haringina ba Urana murung sibuna makira. Urana bing kubolu murungam sibuna namua. Lipu gaxarea taga rangua kubolu murungam sibuna bing taga rangua Urana, saing Urana taga rangua xauna.
Mana daxanga ba, kubolu murungam sibuna baxagi sibuna makira, bu sanga ba tali haringina maxania mana xaidap suxuyangama. Namua na la li titia tawa bila ina.

Kubolu murungam sibuna xola mana maxuwanga. Ne kubolu murungam sibuna baxagi ba suka maxuwanga mala, namua na maxuwanga namua bing salak xabingama. Lipu gaxarea maxuwa, bing kubolu murungam sibuna baxagi mana te.
Kira murura sibuna namua na Urana murung sibuna makira muga.

Nabu lipu tela harua ba, “Murugu sibuna mana Urana,” ne hauxang sibuna mana riang hatuminga haringinama, bing lipu languangam. Namua na lipu gaxarea murung sibuna mana rianoa te, sanga ba murung sibuna mana Urana te. Namua na bagu rianoa, ne bagu Urana bunging tela te.
Baing hanaunaunga taxap rangua Urana bing: Lipu gaxarea murung sibuna mana Urana bing murung sibuna mana riang hatuminga haringinama xauna.
